text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning the SDK cutover tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Need final tollgate sign-off and a clear pinback plan. If we flip dist tags, we want an easy rollback path.

josh: Acknowledged. What's the canary cohort? and who has veto on the tollgate?

maria: Canary = 5% of GA traffic (internal + shadow clients). Veto = eng lead + devex + docs. @tim you'll do performance checks?

tim: Yep. I'll run the throughput & latency sweep tonight against the canary image. If tail p95 degrades > 20% we abort.

sasha: Docs: I'll stage the deprecation blurb and migration note into the release notes draft. ETA 3h. Also adding a short downgrade section.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary cohort: cohort_id=canary-5pct, image=sdk-v3.4.0-canary, ts=2812345801

josh: Pinback plan: if we detect signer mismatch or checksum failure during publish, we will pin the npm dist-tag back to `stable` and yank the broken artifact. Emergency dist-tag owner @maria.

maria: Confirmed. Add step: notify #support-first when pinback happens so we can open auto-incident and add a rollback note to the release page.

tim: For rollback detection, add two automated hooks: (1) deploy job verifies package checksum and signer before shifting dist-tag, (2) runtime canary health probe; both report to releasebot.

josh: releasebot already listens. We'll add a short script to set `canary` -> `stable` pinback and trigger the rollback playbook. I'll push PR for that script now.

sasha: One more: include a short script snippet in the release notes showing how customers can pin to a specific minor if they need to avoid auto-updates:

```
# pin to 3.3.x in npm
npm install @redwood/sdk@^3.3.0
```

maria: Great. If no objections by EOD we'll run the cutover. Final checklist: canary smoke green (tim), release scripts PR merged (josh), docs blurb staged (sasha), deploy-bot flags set (deploy-bot). :thumbsup: 

tim: Smoke ran — all good. p50/p95 within 5% of baseline.

josh: PR merged and CI green.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot updated flags: auto-pinback=true, notify-channel=#support-first

maria: Locking tollgate for 22:00 UTC. Team on standby 21:45 UTC. If we hit any of the rollback triggers, call abort and we'll run the pinback procedure.

sasha: I'll publish the migration note immediately after canary flips. Will also add a short 'what to do if you see auth errors' bullet.

josh: Noted. Thanks everyone. Let's keep messages concise during the window; use thread for any issues. :rocket:
